extractions.value: Clinical features: permanent muscle rigidity, painful spasms, cerebellar ataxia, pyramidal signs. Electromyography: continuous motor unit activity. Antibody: anti-GAD antibodies in serum. Response to treatment: improvement with diazepam and IV immunoglobulin.
extractions.quote: These findings were observed in our case, but additional involvement of pyramidal tract and cerebellar ataxia were indicative of PEWR rather than SMS...
